title: Submit a Listing
content:
Submit a Listing

Use this page to understand how Aerogela reviews new supplier, manufacturer, distributor, laboratory, and service-provider listings before you start the actual submission form.

Submit a new listing if

  • Your company is not yet listed on Aerogela.
  • You represent a manufacturer, distributor, lab, or service provider relevant to the aerogel supply chain.
  • You can provide an official website and verifiable business details.

Use Claim Listing instead if

  • Your company already has a profile on Aerogela.
  • You want to avoid creating a duplicate listing.
  • You need your existing profile linked to an official representative.

What to prepare

  • Official company name and website
  • Core category: producer, distributor, equipment/materials, or research/service
  • Main products and application fields
  • Country/location coverage
  • A short, factual company description
  • A business email on your company domain whenever possible

Editorial review standards

  • The business must be relevant to aerogel materials, equipment, distribution, testing, or R&D services.
  • The website must be live and attributable to a real organization.
  • Marketing claims may be trimmed or rewritten for consistency and clarity.
  • Incomplete, duplicate, or unverifiable submissions may be rejected.

How the process works

  1. Create an account or sign in.
  2. Complete the listing submission form.
  3. Aerogela reviews the submission for fit, quality, and duplication.
  4. Approved listings are published or refined before publication.

Typical review time: 2–5 business days depending on verification complexity.
